items.title: COP31 - Beko to Showcase Connected Appliances That Tackle Home Energy Use
items.summary: Beko opens its booth (E-0001) at the pavilion of its parent company, Koç Holding, in the COP31 Green Zone at Antalya Expo Center on November 9, with a focus on the energy transition in the home. The booth will show how heat pump dishwashing, induction cooking, connected appliances, efficient cooling and solar panels can help households use less energy and water in their everyday routines.
